rationale: Automatic MINAO remains the compatibility default for older libraries without native Huckel support, guarded to its original FP64 all-electron H-Ar restricted exact CPU HF/KS and CUDA KS domains. Existing densities take precedence, unsupported batches retain Hcore and explicit None rolls back. Current libraries prefer the separately registered native Huckel default.
revisit_condition: Revisit for root/state regressions, complete-endpoint regressions, or broader provider/domain qualification. Do not turn on HF/LDA preliminary solves, DF, UKS, ECP, mixed precision, or unsupported elements through this default.
